title: Start with a weighted input
summary: A weight controls how strongly an input affects a calculation. A bias is a number added afterward. A neural network combines many such calculations.
introduction: A weight controls how strongly an input affects a calculation. A bias is a number added afterward. A neural network combines many such calculations. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain start with a weighted input
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A weight controls how strongly an input affects a calculation. A bias is a number added afterward. A neural network combines many such calculations.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: These Python 3 examples run in a separate Python environment and need no extra package. They teach calculations, not a useful trained AI system. Start with the machine-learning course if inputs and test sets are new.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Deep Learning. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

weight = 2
bias = 1
print(input_value * weight + bias)
blocks.title: Start with a weighted input

blocks.text: The output is 7. First 3 times 2 makes 6. Adding the bias 1 makes 7. These numbers were chosen by us, not learned.
